User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the VibeLink platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

plan.description: Subscription plan of the user (e.g., free, basic, premium, enterprise).

LinkPage.title: LinkPage
LinkPage.description: Represents a Linktree-like page created by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the link page.

title.description: Localized title of the link page.

theme.description: Theme applied to the link page (e.g., emerald, amethyst, bronze).

qrCode.description: URL or data representing the QR code for the link page.

fontStyle.description: The font style for the page.

buttonStyle.description: The style of the buttons on the page.

buttonShadow.description: Whether the buttons have a shadow.

iconsPerRow.description: Number of social icons to show per row.

iconSize.description: Size of the social icons in pixels.

Link.title: Link
Link.description: Represents a single link within a LinkPage.

userId.description: Denormalized user ID for security rules.

imageUrl.description: URL for an image to display with the link.

icon.description: Identifier for an icon to display (e.g., 'instagram').

clicks.description: Number of clicks the link has received.

password.description: An optional password to protect the link.

schedule.description: An optional schedule for when the link is active.

geoTargeting.description: An optional list of country-specific URL redirects.

BusinessCard.title: BusinessCard
BusinessCard.description: Represents a digital business card created by a user.

iconsPerRow.description: Number of social icons to show per row on the business card.

iconSize.description: Size of the social icons in pixels on the business card.

cardDesign.description: Design properties for the physical NFC card.

NFCCard.title: NFC Card
NFCCard.description: Represents a physical NFC card product available in the shop.

name.description: Name of the NFC card product.

imageHint.description: A hint for AI image generation or search.

features.description: A list of key features for the product.

isPrimary.description: Whether this product is highlighted in the shop.

action.description: The call-to-action text for the button (e.g., 'Order Now').

href.description: The destination URL for the action button.

order.description: The display order in the shop.

id.description: Unique identifier for the blog post.

slug.description: URL-friendly slug for the blog post.

description.description: A short description or excerpt of the blog post.

content.description: The full content of the blog post in Markdown format.

imageUrl.description: URL of the feature image for the post.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the post was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the post was last updated.

SocialLink.title: SocialLink
SocialLink.description: Represents a social media link associated with a BusinessCard.

id.description: Unique identifier for the social link.

platform.description: Name of the social media platform (e.g., Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn).

url.description: URL to the user's profile on the social media platform.

color.description: A custom color for the icon.

AnalyticsLinkPage.title: AnalyticsLinkPage
AnalyticsLinkPage.description: Stores analytics data for a specific link page.

AnalyticsBusinessCard.title: AnalyticsBusinessCard
AnalyticsBusinessCard.description: Stores analytics data for a specific business card.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support the VibeLink platform, combining features of Linktree and Vibecard.de. It prioritizes authorization independence, clarity, and scalability. New collections for 'blogPosts' and 'nfcCards' are added to store public data, making it manageable from an admin panel and separating it from user-specific data.

Authorization Independence: Achieved through path-based ownership for user-specific data (LinkPages, BusinessCards, and Links). This eliminates the need for `get()` calls in security rules, allowing for atomic operations.

Structural Segregation: Each collection serves a specific purpose and has a homogeneous security posture. User-owned data is separated from other data, simplifying security rules. A new top-level `analytics` collection is introduced to store aggregated analytics data, separating it from primary user data for performance and clarity.

Access Modeling: Path-based ownership is used for private user data. The 'nfcCards' and 'blogPosts' collections are public-read, admin-write.

QAPs Support:

*   Secure List Operations: Path-based ownership ensures users can only list LinkPages, BusinessCards, and Links associated with their own user ID. There are no global roles, which also aids in QAPs support.

*   Membership Models: Not explicitly used in this version since the application is focused on individual user content. If collaboration were added, the 'members' map would be utilized.

Denormalization Strategy: The `userId` is duplicated within the LinkPage and BusinessCard documents. The `linkPageId` is duplicated within Link documents. This ensures that access control can be enforced based on the document content itself, without needing to traverse the document hierarchy. This ensures authorization independence.
